response.query: Which imputation and weighting strategies (MICE, IPW formulas, survey design weights) are most appropriate for proxy reports and absent/deceased parents?
response.answer: For proxy reports and absent/deceased parents, multiple imputation (MICE) and inverse probability weighting (IPW) are appropriate. Survey design weights can also adjust for non-response bias.
